title: Confocal Endomicroscopy for Permeability of Esophageal Wall in Refractory Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
brief_summary: Confocal Endomicroscopy for Permeability of Esophageal Wall in Refractory Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age \> 18 years
2. Ability to give informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Pregnancy
2. Esophageal varices
3. Prior esophageal or gastric surgery
4. Active gastrointestinal bleeding
5. Evidence of esophageal malignancy
6. Inability to provide informed consent
